name: Desolate [G666]
desc:
Featuring characters inspired by Undertale, Deltarune, Project Moon, internet ARGs, and many other genres, with FNAF content coming soon.

Welcome to DESOLATE, where forgotten things are thrown away. Lost people, failed experiments, and abandoned worlds all end up here.

Explore multiple gamemodes, from killer vs survivors to PvP, boss fights, and more. Unlock characters, collect high-quality skins, complete quests, and progress through our battle pass.

There’s always something new waiting for you.
